text_to_image_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: head-angle reference sheet for a character library. Output ONE landscape 3-columns by 2-rows contact sheet, six equally sized HEAD AND UPPER-CHEST portraits, NOT full-body views. Exact same realistic golden-orange shorthaired tabby cat: very round plush head, small upright pink-inner ears, huge round dark olive eyes, broad ivory muzzle/chin/chest, pink triangular nose, fine white whiskers, delicate orange forehead tabby stripes. Keep cream woven apron with narrow straps and blue fish patch; no hat, bow or other garments. Reading order: top left perfectly straight-on centered front, top middle three-quarter with nose pointing toward LEFT of image, top right three-quarter with nose pointing RIGHT; bottom left exact 90-degree profile pointing LEFT, bottom middle exact90-degree profile pointing RIGHT, bottom right exact180-degree back-of-head showing ears and apron neck straps. All head rotations genuinely distinct, opposite profiles not duplicates; rear panel contains NO face or eye. Eye-level camera, head upright, neutral attentive expression, identical cat scale; complete ears and entire head with safe margins in each panel. Keep anatomy that of a real cat, never humanoid. Soft pale warm ivory studio/window background, bright diffuse morning daylight, delicate realistic fur strands and natural skin of nose, cream neutral-warm photographic quality. Thin cream dividers. No titles, labels, numbers, text, UI or watermarks.
